Fudbalski klub Inđija is a football club based in the city of Inđija, Serbia. They compete in the Serbian Municipal League, the seventh tier of the national league system. FK Inđija officially announced its withdrawal from the Serbian League Vojvodina on 25 July 2026 after large amount of debts they were unable to pay.
